topics.title: Spider-Man swings past Endgame
topics.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day set a new North American opening-weekend record, with Sony reporting $360 million in U.S. and Canadian ticket sales.
topics.discussionPrompt: What keeps Spider-Man feeling fresh after so many versions: the jokes, the drama, the costume, or just everybody wanting a friendly neighborhood hero?

topics.title: News veterans head to class
topics.summary: Former 60 Minutes correspondents Scott Pelley and Sharyn Alfonsi are joining Columbia Journalism School as journalists in residence for the academic year.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather learn reporting from a polished anchor, a scrappy local journalist, or someone who has made every possible newsroom mistake already?

topics.title: Produce outbreak prompts caution
topics.summary: Michigan reported two deaths tied to cyclosporiasis as U.S. officials continue investigating a large outbreak linked in part to contaminated lettuce served at restaurants.
topics.discussionPrompt: When food safety news breaks, do you change what you order for a while, or do you trust the system to sort it out?

topics.title: Online rumors stir border rush
topics.summary: AP reports that viral misinformation helped drive a sudden rush by migrants toward Spain's Ceuta enclave, raising questions about social platforms and official communication.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a rumor spreads fast enough to move crowds, who has the first responsibility to slow it down: platforms, governments, or people sharing it?
